text: The Scheme is sanctioned by the Court and will become effective on 10 September 2026
New addition: Indicative all-share offer of 0.01108 new Greenland Energy share for each 80 Mile share. PUSU deadline is 6 October 2026
Checkit has received several non-binding indicative proposals and the Board  is seeking to bring the FSP to a conclusion over the coming weeks
